name: MCP capability drift guard
summary: Block toolkit MCP calls whose server or tool name is not pinned, or whose supplied description differs from the pin.
description: A deterministic fail-closed pre-tool gate that accepts only curated Youdede MCP server and tool identities from a generated pin registry and rejects unknown or description-drifted capabilities.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks toolkit MCP tool calls when the server or tool name is not pinned, or when the client supplies a description that differs from the pin; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not trust MCP annotations, server names, or tool descriptions that are absent from the generated pin registry.
It does not silently accept added, removed, or renamed tools from curated servers, or description-drifted tools when the client supplies the description.
It does not widen egress, secret, filesystem, subprocess, or mutation authority for an MCP server.

entrypoints.purpose: Compare a toolkit MCP tool call and any observed inventory with the generated capability pin registry.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block toolkit MCP tool calls when the server or tool name is not pinned, or when a supplied description differs from the pin, without deferred work.
